Daler Mehndi Controversy: Uttarakhand Minister, Film Body Weigh In

Uttarakhand Minister Subodh Uniyal stated that singer Daler Mehndi should have disclosed his illness before performing at an event. Meanwhile, Mika Singh, Daler Mehndi's brother, thanked the film fraternity for their support and demanded an apology from the Uttarakhand minister. A film body has also written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi regarding the singer's "public humiliation."
